what: SessionStart hook cleanup rules: (1) start/resume: DON'T touch any tracking files — other sessions might be concurrent. (2) clear/compact: clear only THIS session's tracking (recalled-paths, searched-queries, correction-pending, compact-pending). Never touch other sessions. For compact this is belt-and-suspenders with PreCompact Phase 2. Each session only manages its own files.
why: User corrected: original implementation cleaned ALL other sessions' files on start, which would break concurrent sessions. No mechanism exists to know if another session ended or crashed. Each session manages only its own tracking.
